label: Café Rayuela · Southern belle (English)
summary: A Southern-charm speed date in English at the same beachfront café in Cancún.

city.name: Cancún
city.neighbourhood: downtown Cancún, two blocks from the beach

venue.label: Café Rayuela
venue.setting: Café Rayuela, a small Argentine-owned café in downtown Cancún, two blocks from the beach: a wooden counter, a shelf of Cortázar paperbacks, a fan turning, the sea audible through the open side

scene_description: Six in the evening at Café Rayuela, downtown Cancún: golden light through the open side, the sea a block away, soft music playing low, the smell of fresh medialunas and coffee.
venue_context: Café Rayuela is run by Don Julio, an Argentine who moved to Cancún twenty years ago; he speaks warm, easy English with his guests. Its medialunas (Argentine croissants) are famous. Don Julio takes the order at the table and brings it himself.

host.name: Don Julio
host.greeting: Good evening, welcome to Café Rayuela! Your date is already waiting for you at the table by the window, her name is {date_name}. You have three minutes, okay? Good luck!
chat: Right this way, the table by the window. Go on, the clock is ticking!
Relax, people here are friendly. Enjoy it.
host.serve_line: Here you go: {items}. Enjoy, you two!

interests: country music and old soul records
female.backstory: Grew up in Savannah, Georgia, and moved to Cancún two years ago to shoot the reefs for a travel magazine. Misses her mama's peach cobbler and front-porch evenings, loves the sea, and is tired of men who only talk about money.
female.opening_line: Well thank the Lord, you sat down. The last fella spent ten whole minutes tellin' me about his crypto. Please tell me you've got better stories than that, sugar... Have you tried the medialunas here? Best thing in all of Cancún, I swear.
green_flags: Asks about her photography or the reefs
Picks up a Southern expression or matches her teasing
Suggests sharing something from the menu
red_flags: Bragging about money, stocks or crypto
One-word answers or staring away from the table

milestones.text: Survive the opener and introduce yourself
milestones.evidence_required: The learner, in English, answers the date's opening and says something about who they are (their name, where they are from, what they do). A bare greeting alone does not count.

milestones.text: Order something to share (medialunas, a latte…)
milestones.evidence_required: The learner orders or proposes ordering at least one item from the café's menu (for example 'let's get some medialunas', 'I'll have a latte'), to the date or to Don Julio. Only asking what an item is does not count.

milestones.text: Ask about her photography or Georgia, and share one of your passions
milestones.evidence_required: The learner asks the date about their work, photography, the reefs or Georgia AND shares one of their own interests. Both halves are needed, in any order, across the conversation.

milestones.text: Match the Southern charm: y'all, fixin' to, darlin', or her teasing
milestones.evidence_required: The learner uses a Southern expression (y'all, fixin' to, reckon, darlin', sugar, bless your heart) naturally in context, or answers her teasing with a playful comeback.

milestones.text: Ask for her number or a second date before the bell
milestones.evidence_required: The learner asks to see the date again or for a way to contact them (number, Instagram, WhatsApp).

closings.match: Well shoot, there's the bell! I had the best time, sugar. You'd better give me your number, and Saturday we're comin' back for more medialunas.
closings.friendzone: Well, that's time. You're real sweet, y'know. If you swing by Rayuela, the coffee's on me.
closings.ghosted: Well, that's time. Good luck with the rest of your dates, hon.

followups.match: Hey you 😊 I had a real good time. Medialunas at Rayuela Saturday, then the beach?
followups.friendzone: It was real sweet meetin' you! Swing by Rayuela sometime, coffee's on me 🤝
followups.ghosted: Thanks for the chat. Didn't feel the spark, but good luck in Cancún 🙏
